title: Raging
summary: RA'GING, participle present tense [from rage.] 1. Acting with violence or fury. 2. adjective Furious; impetuous; vehemently driven or agitated; as the raging sea or tempest. RA'GING, noun Fury; violen

inlines.v: RA'GING, participle present tense [from rage.] 1. Acting with violence or fury. 2. adjective Furious; impetuous; vehemently driven or agitated; as the raging sea or tempest. RA'GING, noun Fury; violence; impetuosity. Jonah 1:15.
